text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Suspects who attacked a policeman guarding the Russian consulate arrested. The policeman was seriously injured last month when the attackers opened fire on him.
- Commerce minister discusses trade ties with visiting British Board of Trade president.
- Defence Ministry undersecretary Sheikh Salman left for the United States on an official visit, will attend the commissioning ceremony of a new frigate for Bahrain's navy.
- Bahrain plans to boost small and medium industries.
